name: 48176 · Saline, MI
findings: ZIP 48176 (Saline) has 110 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48176 (Saline) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
